field_matrix.statement: C2/C0 separation is carried by content, not by naming. Every decisive slot (extension class, equation concept, conclusion type, ledger direction, falsifier target, forbidden lists) differs in value, and the two class-specific sections differ in name AND content (class_boundary + conventions vs c0_specifics + class_identity_variants). The 97 identical leaves are class-neutral scaffolding; in particular conclusion.statement_formal is the same predicate-name string in both files and carries no regularity by itself, so it resolves only through the in-file extension_predicate (frozen_regularity: C2, frozen_equation_concept: classical_ricci) and quantifiers.domains.D3. No C0 conclusion content appears in any positive C2 slot, and C0's positive slots carry C0-specific content; this is not a C0/C2 merge.

class_leakage.detail: C2 positive slots (scope_statement, quantifiers, extension_predicate, topology, regularity, genericity, conclusion, known_obstruction) contain only C2 content. C0/C1/C^{1,1}/H2_loc tokens appear only in boundary, ledger, forbidden-list and anti_scope slots, which is where the artifact's own class_boundary.import_rule permits foreign-class content. No C2 statement is smuggled into the C0 positive slots either: C0's conclusion/quantifiers/D3 are C0-specific and C0.conclusion.forbidden_weakenings explicitly forbids substituting C2. The shared statement_formal string is class-neutral and documented as such in field_matrix.statement.

conclusion_inflation.detail: epistemic_status: open_problem (line 32) and known_status.status: open_problem (line 285). promotion_rule requires a checked proof artifact + artifact_refs (line 33). l1_ledger_refs marks T-401 as 'absence of evidence', T-305 provisional/unresolved, T-402 as 'the authors' stated interpretation, not a theorem' (lines 279-282), and T-514/T-520 as model-class results with 'do not transfer' (lines 282-283). The non-vacuity argument is explicitly downgraded to an unverified proof obligation (lines 187-188) and the genericity excluded set is unresolved (line 161). No theorem or counterexample is promoted from a model or calibration.

hard_failures.description: The declared consistency-evidence hash does not equal the measured bytes of the declared path. The live evidence and FROZEN rev28 agree on 9e335e9b; only the schema carries 675a99d0. The addendum's instruction is explicit: a declared sha256 that does not equal the measured file is a hash-bound hard failure. The schema's own refresh rule is therefore not satisfied on the evidence leg, and an accept at pin 5476a3f2 would rest on a dead evidence pin.

The frozen extension predicate leaves two structural conventions unpinned that the C0 sibling explicitly freezes. (a) iota: M -> M' is required to be 'an isometric embedding' with no regularity, although iota_* g = g' is a classical pullback and needs at least C2 (the C0 file pins 'C-infinity isometric embedding (smooth category)' and records that freezing it removes the R2-04 ambiguity). (c) plus topology.extension_topology require M' to be 'a connected 4-manifold' with no manifold category, although a C2 metric and classical Ric need at least a C2 atlas and the C0 file pins SMOOTH (C-infinity) with the stated reason that a merely topological manifold cannot carry a classical tensor field (worker-16 F2b-16-03). Because the conclusion is the non-existence of an extension, an unpinned extension category changes the statement's content; the class is not fully frozen.

findings.description: falsifier.schema_falsifiers[0] calls a statement whose conclusion is 'really C0 or H2_loc inextendibility' bound to this class 'conclusion inflation'. Per the artifact's own ledger, C0- and H2_loc-inextendibility entail C2-inextendibility, so those conclusions are stronger, not inflated, and binding them to C2 would understate them (the real C2 inflation risk is a restricted/weaker conclusion, e.g. inextendibility only among globally hyperbolic extensions). The C0 sibling's analogous bullet (C0 file line 264) uses the label correctly. The detection intent is sound; the label is not.

provenance.no_status_claim says 'no assertion that this class is proved, refuted, or open; L1 owns the ledger', while the file asserts epistemic_status: open_problem and known_status.status: open_problem. The intent (schema does not adjudicate literature status) conflicts literally with the top-level status fields; two readers will disagree on which governs.

revision_history index 9 carries at 2026-09-11T23:30:35, earlier than index 8 at 2026-09-12T00:30:00, and is flagged unused: true with no documented semantics for the flag; index 10 is later again. A non-monotone history with an undefined 'unused' marker makes the audit trail ambiguous, especially since FROZEN rev27 states duplicate revised_at keys were collapsed into this list.

non_vacuity.condition is phrased as a restriction ('the class must be applied to data whose maximal development is not future geodesically complete') while quantifiers range over every D in G_r. If the condition were read as a class assumption it would silently restrict the statement; the surrounding c2_specific_note and vacuity_falsifier frame it as citation discipline, but the field name and wording do not.

regularity.i_plus_regularity says 'gtilde extends to I+ with C^k regularity, k >= 3; k is part of the assumption', but k is not bound in D0 or in the quantifier list, so it is unclear whether k is existentially or universally quantified over the class. The C0 sibling carries an explicit hypotheses_reconciliation note for this k>=3 assumption; F2a does not.

The tier-1 falsifier's decisive step (non-meagerness of the extendible set) is non-machine-checkable; the other steps only check a candidate. This is honestly declared, but the falsifier is therefore not fully decidable and should not be treated as one by the gate.

class_boundary.provenance.status says 'input to the canonical revision; one sentence corrected', which understates the draft-to-rev12 delta recorded across revision_history (transfer/containment repairs, well-typedness repair, iota/equation freezing, etc.). Provenance wording should not be read as a measure of how much of the draft survived.

class_boundary.one_way_implication writes 'E(C0) entails E(C2)' where E(x) denotes a set of extensions; the intended statement is that E_C2 is a subset of E_C0, hence C0-inextendibility entails C2-inextendibility. The reason clause disambiguates, but the notation is loose and conflicts with the set notation used at line 147.

strengths: No class leakage in any decisive C2 slot; sibling tokens are confined to boundary/ledger/negative slots.
No conclusion inflation: open status, promotion rule, model-class 'do not transfer' clauses and unverified obligations are all explicit.
Falsifier is tiered correctly (tier 1 class refutation via non-meagerness; tier 2 only the for-all-data strengthening).
The C2/C0 separation is real content separation, not a naming difference, and both nodes publish separate canonical files with separate pointers.
The artifact records its own weak points (diffeo quotient, meagerness of the excluded set, non-vacuity membership, unverified vacuity argument) instead of asserting them.
